item.title: Version 0.8.5
item.description:
What's New

  • Pro: a Downloads sheet tracks Workshop downloads with progress, speed and stalls; you can cancel downloads, and failed ones come back after a restart so you can retry them — thanks @Aleem2Z (#145)
  • The weather layer works on a display without a wallpaper and stays when you clear the wallpaper; schemes no longer change it
  • Lite: importing a Pro backup keeps its scene displays, and the summary counts the ones Lite cannot run
  • The System Wallpaper panel flags an extension copy that is out of date

Improvements

  • Playback actions use the same short names (Pause, Play, Previous, Next) in the menu bar, the display page and VoiceOver
  • The display inspector gets narrower in narrow windows
  • Pro: Workshop tags and resolution labels use Wallpaper Engine's own Chinese wording, and multi-display and portrait resolution tags are translated
  • Pro: Download and apply shows one notice instead of two
  • Pro: the Workshop page rescans downloads less often, which puts less load on the macOS bookmark service
  • Automation queue rows use friendly titles, show the folder of local videos, and keep the row you previewed selected

Bug Fixes

  • Pro: perspective and tilted composition layers render in place instead of covering the screen
  • Pro: shader inputs, cursor ripples, flipped layers and text, and puppet layers render correctly — thanks @Aleem2Z (#146)
  • Pro: scene scripts get canvasSize as a vector, get copies from transform getters, and handle missing layers in createLayer and getLayer
  • Pro: applying an installed Workshop item straight to a display cancels the apply that its update download queued for another display
  • Pro: a waiting apply keeps its status, refreshed approvals retry, and download failure reasons are translated
  • Transitions across several displays use the displays' current positions
  • The music visualizer stops capturing audio when Reduce Motion is on
  • The CPU gauge legend fits its column in every language

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen.app" once; updates Loomscreen installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
